testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect marking-menu sub-environment choices without changing selection: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1928:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect marking-menu sub-environment choices without changing selection ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the customization dialog is open on the Marking Menu tab in the MCAD Software ✔ And Environment is "2D Sketch" ✔ And Sub-Environment is "None Selected" ✔ When the user opens the Sub-Environment selector ✔ Then the available choices include "Arc", "Circle", "Dimension", "Line", "Point", "Sketch Block", "Sketch Pattern", "Spline" and "Text" ✔ And "None Selected" remains highlighted ✔ When the user dismisses the selector without choosing an option ✔ Then Sub-Environment remains "None Selected" ✔ And no customization change is pending
